After-v2.dc.html.title: After combat v2 · loot uses the gear screen's item pop-up (hover or long-press); card hexes no longer squished

After-v3.dc.html.title: After combat v3 · less text: no fight difficulty, draw count, hand note, details hint or level-up sentence

After-v4.dc.html.title: After combat v4 · "Party level 4" turns into "Level 5!" in place; no inventory subtitle

After-v5a.dc.html.title: After combat v5a · bigger pieces: 60px card and loot hexes, larger portraits, XP bar moved to the bottom row

After-v5b.dc.html.title: After combat v5b · rewards as a reveal: each reward shows big in the middle, then settles; buttons appear at the end (tap the panel to skip)

After-v6.dc.html.title: After combat v6 · v5b + a Legendary suspense flip: it arrives face-down, shakes leaking orange light, then flips like a coin (Commons and Rares unchanged; item is a placeholder)

After-v7.dc.html.title: After combat v7 · FINAL (Oct 26): XP is granted after the loot: rewards reveal first, then the XP bar fills, then "Level 5!" and the buttons

LevelUp-v2a-Level4.dc.html.title: Level up v2a · plain level (4) under the screen-text rules: big ability tiles with coins like the gear screen, a dot/tick per section instead of the to-do line, Max HP +[HP]

LevelUp-v2b-Level5.dc.html.title: Level up v2b · level 5: subclass, cards and spells as named icon hexes; tapping one opens a pop-up (over the character card) with the blurb and Choose. Icons are placeholders; blurbs are the docs' current ones, to be rewritten

LevelUp-v3a-Level4.dc.html.title: Level up v3a · ability coins stay on one line (they overlap slightly past what fits instead of wrapping)

LevelUp-v3b-Level5.dc.html.title: Level up v3b · level 5 with one-line coins (try Mel: DEX 4 → 5). Blurbs still the docs' current ones

LevelUp-v4a-Level4.dc.html.title: Level up v4a · plain level, same as v3a (paired with v4b)

LevelUp-v4b-Level5.dc.html.title: Level up v4b · the new subclass blurbs in the pop-ups (Holy Defender's is still a placeholder while it's reworded)

LevelUp-v5a-Level4.dc.html.title: Level up v5a · plain level, same as v4a (paired with v5b)

LevelUp-v5b-Level5.dc.html.title: Level up v5b · all subclass blurbs in, including Holy Defender's

LevelUp-v6a-Level4.dc.html.title: Level up v6a · plain level, same as v5a (paired with v6b)

LevelUp-v6b-Level5.dc.html.title: Level up v6b · new and upgraded cards and spell picks drawn as combat's hotbar cards (class band, AP hex, New / ↑ badge; the picked spell lifts). Blaster gets a burst icon. Card icons are placeholders

LevelUp-v7a-Level4.dc.html.title: Level up v7a · plain level, same as v6a (paired with v7b)

LevelUp-v7b-Level5.dc.html.title: Level up v7b · new and upgraded cards open pop-ups too; upgrades rename the card (e.g. Second Wind+, Second Ward, Magical Blade)

LevelUp-v8a-Level3.dc.html.title: Level up v8a · level 3: martials gain one class card (Action Surge, Poison Blade); casters pick 2 level-3 spells from any school or order. No ability point

LevelUp-v8b-Level4-Feat.dc.html.title: Level up v8b · level 4: a general feat pick only. One scrolling list (race and background feats first, then general) with details on the right; Show all reveals locked feats with the missing requirement. Hero is a Folk Hero here; companions have no background set

LevelUp-v8c-Level5.dc.html.title: Level up v8c · level 5: subclass, then the new card and upgrade (martials) or a spell pick (casters), then the party milestone. No ability point

LevelUp-v8d-Level8.dc.html.title: Level up v8d · level 8: place +1 ability point (ability score increases are at 8 and 16 only)

LevelUp-v9a-Level3.dc.html.title: Level up v9a · level 3: martials see their whole class kit with the new card marked; casters fill 2 spell slots on top from spells grouped by school or order below (tap a filled slot to clear it)

LevelUp-v9b-Level4-Feat.dc.html.title: Level up v9b · feats: Back/Next move into the details panel so the list runs full height; rows show 2-line effects; Skilled and Weapon Training pick their option in the details panel before Choose (try Skilled on the hero, Weapon Training on Mel)
